title: Valuation AI Briefing - Wed 25 Nov 2026: Grant Thornton's human-first audit, Stanford on AI detectors in court, how firms really review AI, a hospital's ChatGPT breach
description: A quiet pre-Thanksgiving day, focused on what reviewing AI work really means: Grant Thornton's 'human goes first' challenge to agent-led audits, a Stanford study showing AI detectors are unreliable on court filings, new data on how accounting firms check AI output, the AICPA's proposed SOC 2 AI guidance, Tahoe Forest's ChatGPT PHI breach, Parallel's Methodim deal, and deterministic-core design from Savant Labs, ILS and Visual Studio.
